title: Compliance Rating Scheme: A Data Provenance Framework for Generative AI Datasets
abstract: We introduce the Compliance Rating Scheme (CRS), a comprehensive framework for evaluating the legal and ethical provenance of datasets used in training generative AI models. CRS provides a systematic approach to assess data collection practices, licensing compliance, and consent mechanisms.

title: Robust Deepfake Detection via Multi-Modal Analysis
authors: Maty Bohacek, Alice Smith, Bob Johnson
abstract: A novel approach to detecting AI-generated media by combining visual, audio, and semantic cues. Our method achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple benchmarks.

title: Towards Transparent AI Systems: A Framework for Explainability
abstract: We propose a unified framework for building AI systems that are inherently interpretable and can provide meaningful explanations for their decisions.

title: Auditing Large-Scale Datasets for Bias and Quality
authors: Maty Bohacek, David Lee, Emma Chen
abstract: An automated system for detecting and quantifying various forms of bias in machine learning datasets, with applications to content moderation and recommendation systems.

title: Fair Machine Learning: From Theory to Practice
abstract: A practical guide to implementing fairness constraints in machine learning pipelines, with case studies from healthcare and criminal justice.

title: On the Quality of Synthetic Training Data
abstract: An empirical study of how synthetic data quality affects downstream model performance, with recommendations for data generation practices.
